title: Strain -> Bethe Coupling (Fork epsilon): deformation energy drains excitation
hypothesis: Boundary shear strain (EXP-511) acts as a deformation-energy drain on the EXP-509 excitation reservoir: E*_eff = beta_Z*(1-(strain/eps_ref)^2). The level-density parameter a (substrate schema mass) is UNCHANGED -- strain is energetic, not structural. A world that shears past the critical strain eps_ref overheats (dS_cit<0) and is rejected by the Citadel: mechanical instability becomes an informational breach. strain=0 recovers EXP-509 exactly.

equations.frac: min((strain/eps_ref)^2, 1)   # elastic-energy fraction (quadratic, Hooke 1/2 k x^2)

rejected_alternatives.scale_a_by_strain (option b): re-entangles the fixed substrate constant a with dynamical state -> the EXP-509 double-count trap; dissolves the friction. REJECTED.
rejected_alternatives.additive heat raising E* (option a, naiv: raising E* increases H_in -> easier admission (wrong sign). Corrected to a SUBTRACTIVE deformation-energy drain.

backreaction_firewall: strain feeds the Citadel VERDICT (a read), never mutates geometry, the eigenvector, or the forward E*. Opt-in (separate function / gate) like EXP-509 bethe_gate -> existing forks unchanged.
engine_scope: engine/validity.py: ADDITIVE bethe_citadel_strain_512 + is_bethe_strain_512 only. state.py/operators.py/confluence.py FROZEN. Orchestration in game/observability/multivelocity.py.

[4] a UNCHANGED across strain (substrate constant; strain never scales a)
[6] overheat at eps_ref: strain=eps_ref -> E*_eff=0 -> reject

[8] no-regression: bethe_citadel_509 default path unchanged (coupling is a separate opt-in fn)
